pieces.Text: If you have performed your daily obedience, three times per day, you can hold a creature underwater for

rounds. Each round, as long as the creature is submerged and holding its breath, it is healed of 1d8 + 5 points of damage. If the creature doesn't hold its breath, it doesn't receive healing that round. If you submerge a creature and heal it for fewer than
rounds, it still counts as one use of this ability.
